scope: Independent local source and binding review only; no remote query, SSH, staging, admission, launch, model or data-payload read, or trainer invocation.

recipe.review: The body argv exactly matches the frozen recipe and its compact JSON digest. It is a full six-epoch CUDA fit, seed 1001, seeded batch order, batch 16/chunk 2000, H256x2, parent epoch-3 initialization with inherited preprocessing, base representation, AdamW, FP32, grad stats, training-state save, and no fit-time evaluation. The homogeneous cache is consumed at scale 1.0 after its construction-time 0.8125 multiplier.

identity_and_lineage: Before mutation, the body checks the pinned 167-file source manifest and exact file inventory, canonical split and registered data identities, teacher metadata, cache contract/acceptance/exact stop, per-split ordered fit memberships and output membership sets, stat-only array identities, dictionary acceptance/stop and artifact hash/stat, and accepted parent epoch-3 checkpoint/acceptance/stop.

The embedded child-profile acceptance and exact-stop bytes are SHA-bound and validated against the accepted invocation. The profile checker requires 60 completed finite updates, no skips/nonfinite steps, no checkpoint or quality claim, the captured initial-state log proof and 211→467/23→25 parent-preservation predicates. Its existing empty run directory is accepted only when the captured stat-only inventory says present/physical/empty and the live path is a nonsymlink physical empty directory.
resource_and_mutation_guards: Fresh parent cgroup ownership/population and memory headroom, selected-GPU free reserve and foreign-process preservation, physical scratch filesystem with at least 25 GiB free, absent CONTROL unit, and absent output/run paths are checked before staging; destination and unit absence are checked again before create-only staging.

The unit is bounded to CPUQuota 100%, MemoryHigh 7.5 GB, MemoryMax 8 GB, swap 0, RuntimeMaxSec 86400, one visible selected GPU with a 4 GiB allocator cap and 1 GiB reserve, loader workers 0, and one-thread numerical libraries.
review_findings.durability: Submission and post-submit query success, nonzero, timeout, and OS-error outcomes are represented in the single durable launch record; timeout bytes are base64-preserved and there is no blind retry.

decision: Conditional source pass. Root must independently run and preserve all fresh admission gates immediately before any create-only action; this review does not authorize or establish an admission, launch, fit completion, or scientific result.
